headline: Lynn extend winning run at Florida Southern
dek: Lynn's win at Florida Southern was their fourth in a row, after victories at Barry and over Rollins earlier in the week. Fifth on the table, eight points behind Florida Tech, they have lost none of their last six matches.
displaced_by: The dek named its days by weekday, and those days have gone out of date: read on Tuesday 10 November, 'at Barry on Tuesday' now points at the wrong Tuesday. The story is the same and the headline stands. Only the dek changed, and it now places each win by ground instead of by day.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Florida Southern have outscored every other programme, but goals have not settled the table: Florida Tech lead it on a total from the middle of the pack.

wire.line: Florida Tech finish the conference season top of the table, Embry-Riddle second.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic's home matches against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's home match against Trinity in September, have all passed their date with no result.

next_match.line: AUM have already beaten both Saint Leo and Tampa on this ground, in August.
